svg.title: ANAVO system architecture
svg.desc: Hybrid classical and quantum resource allocation. Clients (household and housing society) call a FastAPI orchestration layer with admission control and an async job queue. The solver plane formulates a binary allocation problem, solves it exactly with enumeration and MILP, and in parallel encodes it as a QUBO, maps it to an Ising Hamiltonian and runs a QAOA circuit on the Qiskit Aer simulator with COBYLA feedback. Every candidate passes an independent feasibility oracle and is compared with the exact optimum.
svg.text: ANAVO · hybrid classical–quantum allocation under hard physical constraints
Fig. 1 — system architecture, data flow and verification path. Every arrow is an implemented code path; every number is measured.
